visualCharacteristics.structure: filter sidebar + h2 groups + h3 link + tagline + paragraph + 2 CTAs + overview modal

contentPattern: One block table for the whole catalog; row kinds are recognised by content. Optional first row, 1 cell, no heading: sidebar note (bold 'Not sure where to start?' paragraph, text, 'Contact Sales' link) shown under the filter (desktop only, as on the source). Category row: 1 cell holding only an H2; following product rows belong to it; the block appends 'N products' and builds the Category filter from the H2s (sorted A-Z). Product row, 3 cells: (1) card: H3 with linked product name, tagline paragraph, description paragraph, link trial CTA (primary button), trial-note paragraph; (2) product type: short plain text 'SaaS' / 'Self-Hosted' (comma-separated for several; data only, builds the Product Type filter); (3) overview (modal): leading icon image paragraph, description paragraph(s), link trial CTA, link 'Learn More', a Wistia URL paragraph (https://fast.wistia.com/medias/) or an image, then highlights as H4 + paragraph. 'See Overview' is generated when cell 3 is present; any part of any cell may be omitted.
